name: parallel_tuple_cost
description: Sets the planner's estimate of the cost of passing each tuple from a parallel worker to the leader backend during parallel query execution.
symptoms: Sequential scan instead of parallel scan
Increased query latency for large scans
tuning_tips: Decrease to encourage more parallelism (e.g., 0.01–0.05) on fast interconnects or low-latency systems; increase (e.g., 0.2–0.5) to discourage parallelism when tuple transfer overhead is high or memory bandwidth is constrained.
